content.short: Web3 Antivirus detects crypto scams and issues warnings before any signatures are made.
content.description: Web3 Antivirus is a security browser extension that helps you browse and transact safely across supported networks. It detects phishing sites and simulates transactions before you sign, providing real-time alerts about 60+ potential risks such as poisoning attacks, wallet drainers, honeypots, scam addresses, risky token approvals, fake tokens, and more. The tool includes a personalized security dashboard and supports revoking risky token approvals while monitoring wallet health to strengthen asset protection.
